home.headline: I turn complex workflows into accessible interfaces.
home.introduction: Hi there. I’m Carl, and I’m eager to apply for BNY’s Director, Product Design role. I bring more than 15 years of experience designing public services and the tools behind them. The opportunity to work through complex problems with your Fund & Investor Solutions team, while helping designers develop their work, is what draws me to this role.
home.projectsIntroduction: I’ve tailored the following case studies to highlight the work and outcomes most relevant to your team: connecting complex workflows, making research useful, and developing patterns that others can build on.
